item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 8 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 8 #SLPRSD
Issued at 02:50 PM 30 August 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Romblon(Calatrava, SanAndres, SanAgustin, Romblon, Looc, Alcantara, SantaFe, SanJose, SanFernando, Magdiwang, Cajidiocan), #Masbate(SanPascual and Claveria) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Romblon(Ferrol, Odiongan and SantaMaria) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
